decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The air conditioning condenser units shall be inaudible at the nearest noise sensitive receptor (residential premises).

Condition : 4 - The level of noise emitted from the proposed plant (specified as two air conditioning condensing units), shall not be less than 10dB(A) below the existing background noise levels (LAeq) when measured over any 24 hour period from the nearest noise sensitive receptor.

Condition : 6 - Informative: Compliance with these conditions should ensure that there is no noise nuisance caused to the occupiers of any nearby premises and there is no increase in the prevailing noise climate.
 
Any approval will not prejudice any action this department may be required to take under Part 3 of the Environmental Protection Act 1990, should a statutory noise nuisance be caused from the operation of these plant.
description: Installation of air-conditioning condenser units to roof of office building
